title: Rho fee table
description: A dark pricing ledger: a two-line 60px heading and a lead, then full-width rows split by hairlines, each with a mono number, a semibold label and a bold value at the right edge followed by a blinking block caret. Rows take a faint tint on hover; fine print closes it.
notes: tone="dark" by default; CSS only (caret blink loops, off with reduced motion)
